Express Towers, Nariman Point — Mumbai (2017).

Environmental graphics, lobby art and wayfinding for the landmark office tower: gold-leaf and gilded-orb wall installations, geometric jali screens, sunburst clocks and wave sculptures set on white marble, brass-lined elevator lobbies, and a clean signage system. The building wears its art.

Environmental graphics & signage — Anirudh Kapoor. A·18.
